desc: Ideate the core difficulty and approach (Tree DP with degree constraints).
Define the DP state and transitions (handling degree 1 vs 4, root vs non-root, and the "at least one degree 4" constraint).
Run the code against the provided sample inputs to ensure correctness.
Test with a custom star graph input to verify the degree 4 root case.
Test with a large input (e.g., N=200,000 line graph) to verify performance.
Verify edge cases (e.g., N=1, N=2, star graph, line graph).
